units.source_text: 中将的情书像风吹荻叶一般不断地飞来，浮舟非常讨厌。

en.t: Letters from the Captain kept flying in like reed leaves blown by the wind, and Ukifune found them deeply repellent.

units.source_text: 她觉得男人的用心都是荒唐可恶的。

en.t: She felt that all men's intentions were absurd and hateful.

units.source_text: 这便使她渐渐回忆起与匂亲王初见面时的情况来，

en.t: This gradually made her recall the circumstances of her first meeting with Prince Niou,

units.source_text: 她对人说：“还是快快让我出家，好叫人断绝了这种念头。”

en.t: and she said to others, "Please let me take religious vows as soon as possible, so that people will give up such thoughts."

units.source_text: 于是学习经文，时时诵读，又在心中念佛。

en.t: So she studied the sutras, recited them from time to time, and also invoked the Buddha in her heart.

units.source_text: 她对世间万事尽行抛舍。

en.t: She cast away every worldly concern.

units.source_text: 因此虽然是个少女，却全无风流之趣。

en.t: For this reason, although she was still a young woman, she had none of the charm of romantic elegance.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧等设想此人是本性生成阴郁的。

en.t: The younger nun and the others imagined that she must be gloomy by nature.

units.source_text: 但其容貌之美，实在使人越看越爱。

en.t: But the beauty of her face truly made people love her more the longer they looked at her.

units.source_text: 因此妹尼僧原谅她的一切缺陷，

en.t: Because of this, the younger nun forgave all her faults,

units.source_text: 朝夜守视着她，借以慰情。

en.t: watching over her day and night and taking comfort from it.
Whenever Ukifune showed even the faintest smile,

units.source_text: 她便如获至宝，欢喜无量。

en.t: she felt as if she had gained a precious treasure and rejoiced beyond measure.
